about: Public Help pictures use synthetic browser Demo data. Run scripts/capture-public-help.mjs against a local Demo server to regenerate the public-* pictures in both themes. Older diagram recipes describe the retained SVG illustrations; no private app or cluster is used.

shots.caption: Tensor parallel gives every node a slice of every layer. Pipeline parallel gives each node its own run of layers
Two ways from an app to a model: straight to the port on the head node, or through the Server on this Mac
Two networks: the LAN joins this Mac and the nodes, and the fabric joins only the nodes
